symptom: Deleting a collection opens a raw browser confirmation dialog inside an otherwise themed dark interface.
evidence: At Compass commit 79b5c2e, CollectionsPage.tsx called window.confirm for collection deletion while the repository already used ConfirmationModal elsewhere. The audit triggered the interaction in the rendered application.
severity_basis: Screen-recording readiness. The source audit rated this finding High; 3 is the schema's numeric encoding for that rating.
fix: Replace window.confirm with the existing themed ConfirmationModal component.
refs: Nielsen Norman Group heuristic 4: Consistency and standards
